decision.question: review size
decision.why: one 24-line socket method, a 4-line tool change and a 1-line view fix, each proven headless

findings.text: `Socket.alive()` (public/framework/dev/Socket/Socket.js:58-67) is a second copy of the ping, race and `restart()` logic that `Outbox.ping()` already has (core/Item/Outbox.js:130-136, `heartbeat = { every, wait }`). Law 6 says one of everything: put the ping-and-restart in one Socket method (for example `Socket.probe(wait)`) that both call, and keep only the timers and wake events separate.
The comment on `restart()` (Socket.js:77) says only Outbox.js calls it. `alive()` and `Link`'s retry now call it too, so the comment is stale and should be updated.

The sub-page card comes from `/(^|\/)LivePage\.js$/` on `page_class()` (Servex/agents/Subpages.js:52). A class that extends LivePage under another file name gets no card, which is the safe default. The task has no dry-run or test of `Subpages.add`; the only proof is the scratch-page run in requirements.md.
A ping that times out leaves its resolver in `this.requests` (Socket.js:347-354), so the array grows by one entry per dead check. This is negligible, and Outbox does the same.

Requirements, docs and indexing: all three asks are met and written in the owner's terms. dev/Socket/readme.md and doc/backoff.md, core/Page/doc/subpages.md and live/readme.md are all updated, and I found nothing unindexed. A fresh agent can continue from requirements.md alone. The Servex restart caveat is stated in both requirements.md and live/readme.md.

answer.reply: Fixed in 1fee3331d: one Socket.ping(wait, who, still) holds the ping, the race and the restart; alive() and Outbox.ping() both call it. Outbox.test (8 checks) and the half-open probe (A2 arrives after the new connection) pass.
Fixed in 1fee3331d: the restart() comment now says ping() calls it, from alive() or core/Item/Outbox.js.
Kept on purpose: only a parent whose class file is LivePage.js gets the card; any other page keeps its Pages footer only. The scratch-page run is the proof; it goes live at the next Servex restart.
Left as is: one entry per dead check, the same as Outbox did before, and the restart replaces the socket that owned it.
